news.title: Falcon-Emirati 聚焦阿联酋阿拉伯语方言与文化语境
news.body: 团队在 Falcon-H1-Arabic 基础上开发 7B 方言专用模型，目标是理解阿联酋口语、诗歌和谚语中的语义与文化背景。文章强调标准阿拉伯语能力不能替代方言理解，实际适用性仍需场景化评估。
news.title_original: Falcon-Emirati: When an LLM Learns the Dialect, the Culture, and the Nuance

news.title: Google 报告讨论智能体隐私与安全的情境边界
news.body: 工作坊报告借鉴情境完整性理论，提出应以具体场景的行为规范约束智能体，并在系统、模型、用户与生态层面协调防护。报告梳理开放研究问题，不能视为这些安全难题已经解决。
news.title_original: Open and Emergent Problems in Agentic Privacy and Security: A Contextual Angle

news.title: OpenAI 公布面向欧盟的文本水印方案及其局限
news.body: OpenAI 宣布为部分 API 模型提供自愿启用水印，并计划逐步在欧盟符合条件的 ChatGPT 与 Codex 文本中加入统计水印。检测存在漏报与误报，短文本、编辑和翻译会影响效果；水印不能证明内容真实或确定作者责任。
news.title_original: Our approach to EU text provenance rules
news.body_original: How OpenAI is approaching text watermarking under EU rules. Learn where watermarks apply, how detection works, and why access starts with researchers.

news.title: OpenAI 宣布测试 ChatGPT 视觉广告并扩展效果测量
news.body: OpenAI 计划本月稍晚先在美国的图像生成场景测试新视觉广告形式，广告会单独标注，并与生成图像分开。公司同时扩展转化与归因合作以及品牌适配评估试点；公告中的早期客户结果不能视为普遍广告效果保证。
news.title_original: Building advertising for the way people use AI
news.body_original: OpenAI introduces a new visual ad format in ChatGPT and expands measurement tools, attribution partnerships, and brand suitability for advertisers.

news.title: ThinkingBox：用后台状态检验智能体是否真正完成任务
news.body: 微软介绍覆盖 507 个有状态业务流程的评测，每项任务重复运行 20 次，检查最终数据库状态与副作用。文章强调工具调用成功和流畅回复不能替代结果验证，单次成功也不能证明重复执行可靠；结论限于所测任务与配置。
news.title_original: The Agent Said It Was Done. The Database Disagreed.

news.title: OpenAI 发布 GPT-6 系列模型使用指南
news.body: 官方指南讨论如何按任务选择模型、控制成本与延迟，并用清晰指令、上下文管理和持续评估支持长任务。指南强调上线前检验任务成功率及数据控制，不能把示例能力视为所有场景下的保证。
news.title_original: A model guide for the GPT-6 family
news.body_original: Learn how startups can choose GPT-6 models, tune reasoning effort, improve prompts and skills, coordinate tools, and prepare workflows for production.

news.title: MIT 研究者用强化学习探索更可靠的交通系统
news.body: MIT 介绍 Cathy Wu 利用机器学习和强化学习研究复杂交通系统，希望降低大量设计方案的建模与比较成本。文章侧重研究方向与个人经历，交通系统的实际改进仍需具体方案与验证。
news.title_original: Computational tools for society’s most complex challenges
news.body_original: Associate Professor Cathy Wu uses reinforcement learning to help map out improvements to transportation and other multifaceted systems.

news.title: AllenAI 开源面向带引用科研报告的 AstaBrief 8B
news.body: 模型将研究问题与检索到的文献片段转成带引用报告，现作为 Asta 的快速模式提供，并开放模型和训练数据。团队希望降低生成耗时与服务成本；报告仍需核查引用是否真正支持结论。
news.title_original: Open-sourcing AstaBrief, the fast report-generation model in Asta

news.title: Google 探索可外部验证隐私保证的联邦学习系统
news.body: Google Research 介绍新系统，在强调数据最小化、匿名化、透明与可审计性的同时，将部分计算移至服务端以改善训练和设备覆盖。隐私保护依赖完整系统与工作负载约束，不能仅凭“联邦学习”名称推定原始数据绝无风险。
news.title_original: Toward provably private learning from federated data

news.title: MIT 介绍记录科技行业劳工运动的新书
news.body: MIT 博士生 JS Tan 与 Clarissa Redwine 在新书中梳理科技员工集体行动及其遭遇的阻力。报道呈现作者对行业权力和劳动关系的分析，属于社会研究与观点讨论。
news.body_original: Writing as a participant and researcher, PhD student JS Tan SM ’22 has co-authored a new book about the rise of tech worker protests and the employer backlash that followed.

news.title: AutoSynthData：从企业智能体的失败中生成训练任务
news.body: ServiceNow 介绍利用目标模型失败与较强教师模型成功案例来识别能力缺口，再生成并验证企业环境中的训练任务。课程随模型进步调整，任务仍需满足环境约束并能可靠检查完成情况。
news.title_original: AutoSynthData: Generating Training Data for Enterprise Agents

news.title: MIT 推出面向青少年的免费 AI 创业学习平台
news.body: Dear Dreamer 将创业框架改编为中学生可自主学习的视频、互动练习和个性化反馈。项目希望扩大青少年创业教育覆盖；目标人数和教育愿景不等于已验证的创业成功率。
news.title_original: 3 Questions: A new resource to empower young entrepreneurs
news.body_original: Martin Trust Center Managing Director Bill Aulet introduces Dear Dreamer, a free platform for middle and high school students who want to learn about entrepreneurship.

news.title: Chatham 用 AI 整理交易证据并辅助人工复核
news.body: OpenAI 客户案例介绍 Chatham 用 Codex 构建交易核验工具，汇集证据、比对关键条款并标记差异。公司称早期测量将复核时间从约 30 分钟缩短到不足 4 分钟，但仍与资深审核人员比较结果，数据不是独立验证的普遍收益。
news.title_original: Chatham scales its capital markets expertise with OpenAI
news.body_original: Chatham Financial uses Codex and GPT-5.6 to build technology and redesign workflows, cutting trade validation from 30 minutes to under 4.

news.title: InstructMesh：让用户局部修复 AI 生成的三维模型
news.body: MIT 等机构开发的工具允许用户指出三维设计中需要修改的部分，改善模型可编辑性并支持后续制造。研究案例包括日用品与机器人部件，生成外观仍需与真实功能和制造约束一起验证。
news.title_original: New tool lets users repair AI-generated 3D models, then fabricate them just the way they want
news.body_original: “InstructMesh” can generate designs for everyday objects that are easy to edit and fabricate for both experts and newcomers to 3D modeling.

news.title: 观点：AI 的重要价值也可能来自平凡的执行工作
news.body: 两位作者讨论创意与执行能力的互补关系：科学突破不仅需要洞见，也依赖实验、组织和基础设施。文章提出不同未来情景，并明确属于作者个人观点，不是 OpenAI 的官方预测。
news.body_original: Advanced AI may matter most for the routine work behind breakthrough ideas. Explore why execution could shape the next economy and the pace of progress.

We introduce Mosaic, a hybrid mesh-particle representation that partitions space into anchored regions containing atom slots. Each slot encodes occupancy, atomic species, and a continuous displacement from its anchor, providing persistent spatial addresses for local conditioning, hierarchical generation, and scalable assembly. papers.title: 观点：协同设计室内光伏、储能与铁电计算器件
papers.body: arXiv:2610.05133v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The exponential, pervasive rise of artificial intelligence (AI), hosted in large data centres, will test the limits of the underpinning infrastructure, including electricity and water supplies, which are becoming increasingly precious resources. We show that conventional MLIPs fail to reproduce the correct stability of intermediate Na concentrations because structural optimization leads to incorrect Fe2+/Fe3+ charge assignments, resulting in incorrect energy ordering and convex-hull predictions. Although the research frontier has mostly shifted toward ultra-high pressure phases above 400 GPa, we show that even the broken symmetry phase observed around 130~GPa requires revisiting due to its intricate coupling of electronic and nuclear degrees of freedom. Here, we develop a first principle quantum Monte Carlo framework based on a deep neural network wave function that treats both electrons and nuclei quantum mechanically within the constant pressure ensemble. papers.title: PF-PINO：将相场方程约束嵌入神经算子
papers.body: arXiv:2603.09693v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Predicting interfacial degradation and microstructural evolution through phase-field modelling is computationally intensive, particularly for parametric studies. While neural operators such as the Fourier neural operator (FNO) offer a promising route to acceleration, the absence of physical constraints compromises their generalisation and long-term stability. Here, we present PF-PINO, a physics-informed neural operator framework that embeds phase-field governing equation residuals directly into the training loss, together with gradient normalisation loss balancing and a staggered training scheme for coupled multi-field systems. science.title: Equivariant generative diffusion learns and generalizes the structural ensemble of amorphous oxides
science.body: arXiv:2610.03973v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Amorphous materials are statistical ensembles rather than definitive structures, and conventional density-functional (DFT) and machine-learned-potential simulations sample only a small part of that ensemble. We present an $SE(3)$-equivariant denoising-diffusion model that learns the configurational distribution of amorphous oxides, so the model itself is the structure database. The learning is data efficient. science.title: MOSAIC: Addressing Space for Local, Steerable, and Scalable Atomistic Generation
science.body: arXiv:2610.04161v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Generative models are opening new possibilities in molecular discovery and materials science. Realizing this potential, however, requires both local control over atomic placement and the ability to assemble large, heterogeneous structures. We introduce Mosaic, a hybrid mesh-particle representation that partitions space into anchored regions containing atom slots. Each slot encodes occupancy, atomic species, and a continuous displacement from its anchor, providing persistent spatial addresses for local conditioning, hierarchical generation, and scalable assembly. science.title: Computing at the Edge Enabled by Indoor Photovoltaics and Ferroelectrics
science.body: arXiv:2610.05133v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The exponential, pervasive rise of artificial intelligence (AI), hosted in large data centres, will test the limits of the underpinning infrastructure, including electricity and water supplies, which are becoming increasingly precious resources. Rather than performing all AI computations in centralized servers, for many functionalities, these can be performed locally across a network of billions of small, autonomous nodes, saving substantial energy costs associated with communication. science.title: Reinforcement Learning on the Discrete Composition Channel of a Crystal Generator: Validated Gains and Reward Hacking
science.body: arXiv:2610.03880v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Inverse materials design is a long-standing goal of computational materials discovery. Generative models for crystalline materials are typically trained to match the distribution of a structure database, while nothing in their training objective points them at specific design goals such as targeted properties. We use group-relative policy optimization (GRPO) to align a generative model based on stochastic interpolants and discrete flow matching with general black-box reward functions through reinforcement learning. science.title: AnchorPose for Geometry-Aware MOF Assembly through Meso-Grained Pose Generation
science.body: arXiv:2610.05843v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Predicting metal-organic framework (MOF) structures from given building blocks requires recovering their positions and orientations in a periodic crystal. The spatial effects of rotation errors are geometry-dependent and anisotropic. The same angular error can produce different atomic displacements depending on block size, shape, and rotation axis. Angular error alone, without reference to the specific block geometry, therefore cannot fully describe the spatial consequences of a pose error. science.title: Importance of Configurational Charge Ordering for Machine Learning Interatomic Potentials
science.body: arXiv:2603.26471v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) enable large-scale atomistic simulations but remain challenged in describing mixed-valence materials where charge ordering strongly influences thermodynamic stability. Here we investigate the role of configurational charge ordering in MLIP structural optimization of the battery cathode material NaFePO4. We show that conventional MLIPs fail to reproduce the correct stability of intermediate Na concentrations because structural optimization leads to incorrect Fe2+/Fe3+ charge assignments, resulting in incorrect energy ordering and convex-hull predictions.
